tools.name: search_books
tools.description: Find a book by title, author or words from its plot, and get the workId the other Siftivo tools take. Suits "what is Babel about", "is Demon Copperhead worth reading", "add Circe to my list" and a half-remembered plot ("the novel about a man alone in an endless house of statues").

tools.name: get_book
tools.description: One book: synopsis, authors, year, series position, genres and its siftivo.com page. Suits "what is X about" and "is X part of a series". For a linked reader it also answers "would I like X", since a book that fits their taste says why. Takes a workId or a full siftivo.com slug.

tools.name: what_to_read_next
tools.description: What to read after one book: the next in its series, more by its author, and books that read like it. Suits "what should I read after X", "is there a sequel to X" and "more like X". For a linked reader, books they already have, hid or avoided are left out, and a book that fits their taste says why.

tools.name: get_author
tools.description: An author's biography and their books, with years. Suits "what else has X written" and "tell me about X". Takes a name, an author id or a siftivo.com slug.

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: A series in reading order: each book's position and year, and whether the series is complete. Suits "what order do the X books go in", "what is book 3 of X" and "is the next X book out". Takes the series name or a series id.

tools.name: get_reading_index
tools.description: This week's Siftivo Reading Index: the fiction and nonfiction books moving most in cultural circulation, ranked, with weeks on the chart and new entries. Suits "what's popular right now", "what is everyone reading" and "the big books this week".

tools.name: recommend_from_description
tools.description: Book recommendations from a mood, theme or subject in the reader's words: "cozy fantasy with found family", "a good book about grief", "something light for the beach". Matches meaning, not titles. For a linked reader, books they already have, hid or avoided are left out, and a result that fits their

tools.name: recommend_from_titles
tools.description: Book recommendations from books the reader loved, named by title: "books like Project Hail Mary", "I loved Circe and Piranesi, what else would I like", a book club's favorite pick. Books they disliked go in avoid ("I loved these three but not that one"). Unresolved titles come back under unmatched,

tools.name: get_my_library
tools.description: The linked reader's shelves: want to read, reading, finished and did not finish, with ratings, percent read and private notes. Suits "what am I reading", "what's on my to-read list" and "what have I finished". status filters to one shelf. Needs a linked Siftivo account.

tools.name: add_to_library
tools.description: Shelve, rate or update one book for the linked reader: want to read (NOT_STARTED), READING, FINISHED or DNF, with the day it happened, a rating in half stars, or a private note. Suits "add X to my list", "I finished X on Sunday" and "just finished X, four and a half stars" (one call: FINISHED, 4.5).

tools.name: get_my_book
tools.description: Which of up to 25 books the linked reader already has, with shelf, rating, progress and their review for each. Takes titles ("Title by Author" resolves best) or workIds. Suits "have I read X", "what did I write about X", "which of these have I read" and checking suggestions before recommending them.

tools.name: remove_from_library
tools.description: Take a book off the linked reader's shelves, discarding its shelf, progress and notes; their rating stays. Suits "remove X from my list". To move a book between shelves, use add_to_library with a new readingStatus. Needs a linked Siftivo account.

tools.name: get_my_taste
tools.description: The linked reader's taste: the books, authors, series, genres and moods they love, what they avoid or quit, and why each counts, in their own words where they gave them. The basis for "what should I read next", "recommend me a book" and "what kind of books do I like" when no book or mood is named. R

tools.name: save_my_taste
tools.description: Save books the linked reader names into their taste, up to 25 at once: favorites ("I loved Project Hail Mary for its humor"), books they disliked, or a list of books they have read. Loved books become favorites with the reader's reason, disliked ones books to avoid, and loved or read books not yet s

tools.name: write_review
tools.description: Publish the linked reader's review of a book, under their name on its siftivo.com page and to their followers. Suits "post this as my review of X" and "change my review of X". The text is the reader's own words, or a draft they approved word for word, and is never padded to reach the minimum. It tak

tools.name: delete_review
tools.description: Take down the linked reader's review of a book, for good. Their star rating and their shelf stay as they are. Suits "delete my review of X". Needs a linked Siftivo account.

tools.name: get_my_journal
tools.description: The linked reader's reading journal: the books they are reading now, with how each is tracked (pages, or time left for audio), where they got to, their totals, and whether today has an entry. With book, that book's recent days and notes instead. Suits "what am I reading", "where was I in X" and "wha

tools.name: write_journal
tools.description: Log a day of reading in the linked reader's journal, one entry per book per day, for up to 10 books. Each takes the reader's local date and a note, a position, or both. Position is page for print or ebook, or minutesLeft for audio; a listener's "4 hours in" is totalMinutes minus 240, so it needs the

tools.name: delete_journal_entry
tools.description: Delete one day's entry for one book from the linked reader's journal, note and position together. The book stays on its shelf where it was. Suits "delete what I wrote about X yesterday". To change a day's note, write_journal with replaceNote. Needs a linked Siftivo account.

tools.name: get_club
tools.description: A book club by its link. Suits "what's this club link?", "what are we reading?", "when do we meet?" and "what's on the ballot?". Anyone gets the club's public preview, and a linked member also gets the current read, next meeting, open poll and the host's pinned message. It never returns chat message

tools.name: get_my_clubs
tools.description: Every book club the linked reader is in, with what each is reading, when it next meets, and whether a vote, an RSVP or unread messages wait on them. Suits "what's going on with my book club?" and "do I have anything to do for book club?".

tools.name: respond_to_club
tools.description: The linked reader's own answer in a book club: join it from a link, leave it, vote in its open poll, or RSVP to its next meeting. Suits "join this club", "vote for Piranesi" and "say I'm coming". The optionId comes from get_club. Members see that the reader joined. Votes show only as totals.

tools.name: start_club
tools.description: Start a book club with the linked reader as host and get back the one link that lets anyone with it join. Suits "start a book club for my Wednesday group". A first book is optional. Nobody is told until the reader shares the link.

tools.name: manage_club
tools.description: For a club's host or moderator: set or finish the book, open or close a poll, set or cancel the next meeting, or post a pinned message from the host. Suits "set up a vote between these three", "we meet the 14th at Noor's", "we finished it" and "ask the club this question". Say what you're about to p

tools.name: suggest_club_picks
tools.description: Books that fit a club's members as a group, each with how many of them it fits and how many have read it, as totals. Suits "what should my club read next?". Pass the workIds to manage_club's open_poll. Empty, with a reason, when too few members have taste on file.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: add_to_library, get_my_book, get_club, get_my_clubs, manage_club · Private data: get_my_library, add_to_library, write_review, write_journal, suggest_club_picks · Public sink: add_to_library, write_review, manage_club · Destructive: remove_from_library, delete_review, delete_journal_entry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: add_to_library, get_my_book, get_club, get_my_clubs, manage_club · Private data: get_my_library, add_to_library, write_review, write_journal, suggest_club_picks · Public sink: add_to_library, write_review, manage_club · Destructive: remove_from_library, delete_review, delete_journal_entry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
